title: Stirling Engine
description: Robert Stirling's 1816 closed-cycle external-combustion engine: heated and cooled gas shuttling between two spaces.

title: Wankel Rotary Engine
description: Felix Wankel's rotating-piston engine: a triangular rotor in an epitrochoid housing, commercialized by NSU and Mazda.

title: Pulsejet
description: The valved pulsejet of the V-1 flying bomb: resonant intermittent combustion with almost no moving parts.

title: Ramjet
description: René Lorin's 1913 air-breathing engine: no compressor, no turbine — forward speed itself compresses the air.

title: Scramjet
description: Supersonic-combustion ramjet: burning fuel in supersonic airflow, flown by NASA's X-43A at Mach 9.6.

title: Gridded Ion Thruster
description: Electrostatic ion propulsion: the NSTAR engine that flew Deep Space 1 and Dawn, with Isp near 3,000 seconds.

title: Hall-Effect Thruster
description: The workhorse electric thruster: Soviet SPT heritage, now flying by the thousands on Starlink satellites.

title: Nuclear Thermal Rocket (NERVA)
description: The Rover/NERVA program (1955–1973): a fission reactor heating hydrogen to twice chemical rocket performance.
